balls.text: Trivedi backs away and pushes a full ball towards short third man for only a single, Asif has conceded only four runs off the final over and has succeeded in keeping Rajasthan under 200
short of a length delivery over the stumps, Trivedi backs away but gets beaten, splendid bowling

Yusuf's run out! He hits a full toss towards deep midwicket and runs the single, he wants the strike back so Yusuf sprints back for the second, Dilshan is the fielder in the deep and his throw to Karthik is flat, fast and accurate, Yusuf dives full length but still can't make his ground

caught! Rawat backs away and tries to pull a short of a length ball from middle and off stump, the top edge goes in the air back towards the bowler, Asif runs to his left and takes a simple caught and bowled
full ball in the block hole outside off, even Yusuf can only squeeze it towards point
full delivery in the blockhole, Rawat does the sensible thing by digging it out towards point for one

well well, McGrath bowls the slower ball on a good length outside off stump, Yusuf spots it well in time, gets into position on the front foot, waits for the ball and absolutely smears it flat over deep midwicket, it's like he's batting with a cudgel
that's a full toss on the pads and Rawat should have hit that, instead he misses and gets hit on the pad, that may have hit the inside edge
McGrath swings the yorker into the blockhole, Rawat defends off the front foot back to the bowler, he has got to look for the single
better length, full and in the block hole, driven down to long on for one
McGrath bowls a slower ball on off stump, Yusuf swings hard across the line and gets a top edge down to the third man boundary
Yusuf clears his front foot out of the way and smashes a length ball from McGrath towards long-off, there's a fielder in the deep but the ball scorches past him

that's a sharp catch! Yomahesh pitches short of a length and outside off stump, Warne uses the length and the width to cut the ball hard, it's travelling quickly towards point where Sehwag takes several steps to his right and then dives to hold the catch with both hands, Warne's got a duck off his first ball
another full toss on middle stump, Yusuf swings the ball towards wide long-on for a single

caught! Jadeja makes a bit of room and slashes at a fuller ball outside off stump, he slices it high in the air towards deep cover where Maharoof runs  froward and to his left from the boundary and takes a well-judged catch

Jadeja's smashed it! He made a movement as if to back away towards leg but then stayed where he was, Yomahesh bowled a short ball and Jadeja pounced, he rocked back and pulled the ball deep over midwicket
another full toss but this time it is in line with the stumps, Yusuff drives towards  long on for one more
he's escaped there, that was a juicy full toss outside off but Yusuf hit it straight to cover
Maharoof ends the over with a yorker on leg stump, Jadeja tries to work the ball to square leg but gets hit on the pad
a low full toss from Maharoof, Yusuf drives the ball towards long on off the front foot, it got there rapidly

that's a beastly hit! The length is a bit short from Maharoof, Yusuf gets on to the front foot and launches the ball into the stands at deep midwicket with a fearsome hit, watch out in the crowd, they need the hard hats that were in supply during the World Twenty20 in South Africa
top-edged but safe! Jadeja tries to pull but the short ball gets to him too quickly and he top edges towards the short fine leg region, Karthik can't get there fast enough
Jadeja pushes the ball off the back foot towards cover, Yusuf sets off for one but Jadeja sends him back
driven off the front foot towards long off for a single

stumped! Watson gives Mishra the charge and tries to loft over long-on, he doesn't get to the pitch of the ball and gets beaten by the length, once the ball begins to spin away from him he has no chance in making contact, Karthik whips of the bails
this time Yusuf misses the hit over deep midwicket but gets hit on the pad for a leg bye
this time it's massive! Yusuf gets down on one knee and carts Mishra over the deep midwicket boundary, the only people close to catching that were the fans at deep midwicket
has he cleared the fielder, only just! Yusuf comes forward and just about chips the ball towards long on, Tiwary is on the boundary but the ball clears him
Yusuf tries to swing across the line but gets beaten by the leg break
defended on the off side, Yusuf came down the track and played it to point

dropped, well he never really got hands to it, Yomahesh is having a shocker today, Watson pulled a short ball in the air towards deep midwicket, he didn't time it well and it should have been a simple catch, Yomahesh ran in from the boundary and simply ran too far forward, the ball flew over his head for a one-bounce four, he reaches his 50 as well
Maharoof bowls a low full toss which Watson drive firmly down the ground, Dilshan runs and dives to his left to save the four
full ball driven towards mid-on for a single

short of a length delivery from Maharoof outside off, it's a slower one as well, Yusuf picks it up early and swats it in the air towards deep midwicket, the fielder runs to his left and dives but doesn't quite get there, the ball bounces just wide of him and goes over the boundary
Maharoof runs in and fires in a yorker, Yusuf digs it out towards the bowler
cheeky! Maharoof bowls a full ball outside off, Watson wanted to paddle the ball towards fine leg but in the end chops it towards third man
played off the pads through square leg for a single
he gets down on one knee and sweeps behind square to get off the mark
bowled him! Kaif decides its time to go after everything and swings across the line at a googly from Mishra, he misses and the ball crashes into the stumps

caught! What a catch! Or has he taken it? Watson smashed the ball flat towards long on, Tiwary sprints in from to boundary and dives full length to take a very low catch, he isn't sure if he's taken it cleanly, Bowden doesn't even refer it to the third umpire, he says it's a bump ball and indeed it was
Kaif pushes the ball towards deep cover for a single

Kaif joins in the big-hitting fun! Mishra gives the ball a lot of flight outside off stump, Kaif gets under the ball and lofts cleanly over the long-off boundary, he freed his arms and swung his bat hard
he's homing in on the block hole now, an excellent yorker from Asif to end the over, Watson defends back to the bowler
another block-hole delivery, Watson manages to get into position and nudge the ball towards deep square leg, Yomahesh fields in the deep but Kaif and Watson sprint two
this time Asif finds the block hole with the yorker, Watson digs it out back to the bowler

and he doesn't disappoint! Asif delivers a low full toss, he was looking for the yorker, Watson comes forward and clips the ball off his pad, he hasn't used too much power but the placement is perfect at deep square leg
Kaif waits in his crease this time and steers a good length ball from outside off towards third man
Kaif steps forward to a good length ball, there's no room to work with and he ends up defending back to the bowler, he'll want to give Watson the strike as much as possible
Watson's lucky there, he tries to slog Mishra for the third time over deep midwicket, the ball turns away from the right-hander and Watson gets a top edge that runs past McGrath at short third man
bowled flatter and quicker outside off stump, Watson moves back and tries to run the ball to third man but misses
Watson slogs again but Mishra beats him with a slower ball, Karthik whips off the bails but Watson's back foot is behind the line
Watson does it again! He gets down on one knee, gets under a flighted delivery from Mishra and slogs him from outside off stump over deep midwicket, that new bat is marvellous
Kaif moves forward, gets down on one knee and drives towards long-on
bowled with flight on off stump, Kaif moves back and defends cautiously on the off side, what a difference in tempo there is when Kaif is on strike
full toss and Watson drives down the ground for two more to end the over, they're steaming along now
and again! Watson pulls with brute force off the front foot and hits the ball flat over the boundary at deep midwicket, he's laying into Yomahesh with haymakers now
and what a difference it's made! the length is short from Yomahesh, Watson gets on to the front foot and pulls with tremendous power, that ball has cleared the roof at deep square leg
short of a length outside off stump, Kaif tries to nudge the ball on the leg side but gets an edge on to his body, they run a single towards the off side on the rebound
Watson stands his ground and hits the ball hard towards long-on, the ball reaches the fielder on the bounce, looks like they are targeting Yomahesh
he overcompensates by bowling too wide outside off stump, Watson slashes hard but misses
too full on the pads, Watson moves forward and swings the ball powerfully off his pads past the fielder at short fine leg for four, poor line when you have a short fine leg
pushed back towards the bowler off the back foot
slides down leg side this time, it's Bowden's cue to entertain the crowd
Watson takes a step down the track but mis-times the attempted loft towards long-on, he wanted to clear the boundary
Kaif leans forward and pushes a flat delivery in front of Tiwary at point
Sehwag fires the throw into the keepers end after Watson collects a single behidn square on the leg side
tossed up on off stump, Kaif moves forward and opens the face of the bat to play the ball towards point
Watson plays the ball off the front foot behind square for one
Watson waits for a good length ball to angle into him and opens the face to guide it to third man

caught! Maharoof has his third! He pitches just short of a length and gets the ball to bounce and hurry on to Tanvir who had come on to the front foot to pull, he was in no position whatsoever and the ball ballooned after hitting high on the bat towards Karthik who held an easy catch
played off the back foot down to third man for a single
the slower ball outside off stump, Watson picks it up early and uses his muscle to loft the ball back over the bowler's head for four
Watson tries to run the ball towards third man but the length is good and the line is too close to off stump, the ball bounces a bit more as well and beats the bat
Maharoof pitches the ball on a good length outside off stump, Watson lets it go through to Karthik
what happened there? Watson came forward and tried to flick a good length ball across the line towards midwicket, the ball seamed a fraction away from him and the leading edge went towards long off
short of a length outside off stump, Watson moves on to the back foot and plays the square drive towards point, didn't connect very well on that occasion
Tanvir takes a strides forward and pulls a short of a length ball towards long on, he hasn't connected well so the ball doesn't reach the boundary, or the fielder in the deep
defended on the back foot towards the bowler
that's classic from Tanvir, he moves forward to a length delivery and smashes it through covers with an orthodox cover drive, lovely timing
punched off the front foot to cover

Maharoof's struck again! He hits the pitch hard and gets the ball to lift on Asnodkar from just short of a length, Asnodkar cuts the ball from outside off stump but can't control it because of the high bounce, he slices it in the air towards Tiwary at point, who takes a smart catch
short of a length outside off stump, Asnodkar slashes at it and gets beaten

caught! and splendidly caught! Smith lifts the ball off his pads once again, he's hit it flat towards deep square leg where Shikhar Dhawan runs in from the boundary and dives to take the catch inches off the ground, superb effort and the relief is visible on Sehwag's face
too full on the pads, Smith's super in that area even when he is injured, he picks the ball up off his pads and lofts it to the deep square leg boundary
Smith backs away a bit too early, Maharoof sees him and bowls the slower ball, smith waits for the short of a length delivery and slices it down to third man
good length to start with outside off stump, Asnodkar tries to drive through the off side and gets an inside edge past his stumps
good length delivery angling into the right-hander, he pushes it on the leg side for a sharp single
short of a length outside off stump, Asnodkar goes after it and slashes wide of first slip for four over, what a dynamo Asnodkar is, he's absolutely electric at the moment
Asnodkar moves back and defends back to the bowler
this time Maharoof has no chance, Asnodkar latches on to a short ball and swings it high and far over long leg, I think he broke a window pane in the stands
defended on the front foot on the pitch

dropped! Asnodkar swivels and pulls a short ball towards long leg where Maharoof gets into position to take the catch but spills it, that flew fast towards him and he tried to take it with fingers facing upwards, Aussie style, looks like the ball hit him on the face as well after bouncing off his hands, to add insult, it goes over the boundary
McGrath finishes the over with a slower ball which beats Smith who tries to run it towards third man
three in a row! Smith makes a bit of room and punches hard at a fuller ball, he dispatches it past mid-off for four more
and again! the length is fuller from McGrath and Smith gets under the ball and smashes it over deep midwicket, the ball bounces just once before going over the fence
he hasn't missed this! Smith gives himself room to a length ball and pulls with tremendous use of the bottom hand over midwicket for four
fuller length angling across the left-hander, smith moves his front foot out of the way and tries to smash it but misses
Smith tries to loft down the ground but mis-hits the ball high over cover, two fielders give chase but they can't get to it

that's too short on leg stump and Asnodkar's cashed in big time, he swivels and pulls the ball firnly towards fine leg, he gets into position so quickly does Asnodkar and he's got amazing hand-eye co-ordination
short of a length delivery outside off, Asnodkar moves on to the back foot and defends
Asnodkar's hitting it with aplomb! He plants his front foot forward and lofts Asif from a good length on the up over extra cover, terrific timing and Asnodkar's fizzing now
Asnodkar defends off the back foot towards backward point, Kaif wanted the single but Asnodkar was ball watching
short of a length and outside off stump, Asnodkar goes after it and cuts hard once again, the ball screams across the outfield and McGrath slides to make the save in the nick of time
Asnodkar's exploded! He stands in his crease, picks up a length ball from outside off stump and slashes hard while opening the face of the bat, he slices the ball over backward point for four
Smith makes room and slashes hard at the ball, McGrath moves it away from the left-hander from short of a length and beats the bat, Smith's struggling here - 5 off 12 balls
McGrath keeps it on a good length around off stump, Smith gets behind the line and defends back to the bowler, he's in quite a bit of discomfort because of his hamstring
Asnodkar pushes the ball towards the leg side and sprints the single

edged and the ball falls short! Asnodkar drives loosely at a good length delivery which seams away from him, he gets an outside edge that falls short towards Sehwag's right at second slip, he gets a hand to it but the ball beats him and runs to the third man boundary

Asnodkar backs away and throws his bat hard at a good length ball, he manages to slice it over point, the ball races across the outfield but Asif runs to his right from third man and slides to save the four
brilliant, McGrath hits the good length around off stump and seams the ball across the right-hander, Asnodkar gets squared up on the back foot and is beaten
strays on to the pads once again, Asnodkar flicks off his hips towards long leg

what a close call! Smith pushes the ball towards cover and sets off for the quick single, as he's running his hamstring begins to give him trouble and he begins to hobble, he's struggling to make his ground as the direct hit comes in from cover at the bowler's end, Smith barely grounds his bat as the ball hits the stumps, that was very very close, Smith's safe but his hamstring is giving him trouble
this time Smith's put it away, the length and line was too far on leg stump once again, Smith moves across and flicks towards the fine leg boundary
terrific fielding! Dilshan's saved a four, the length was too full on the pads, Smith leaned forward and flicked firmly, he's very strong in that area, Dilshan dived to his right and stopped it
Asif raps Smith on the pads with one that pitches around off and middle and seams across the left-hander, Smith had come forward to defend but played down the wrong line, that was missing off
Asif pitches on off and middle and slants the ball into leg, Asnodkar moves across his crease and whips the ball off his pads to long leg where Maharoof slides and makes the save
McGrath finishes a splendid first over, a disciplined line and length on off stump, he can bowl that all day you feel, Smith gets behind the line and blocks
short of a length this time outside off stump, Smith moves back and opens the face to defend on the off side, Smith had moved a bit down the pitch and McGrath saw him coming and shortened the length
Smith tries to flick a fuller ball that swings into him but gets struck on the pad, the keeper and the slips appeal for lbw but McGrath isn't interested, he knew that was missing leg
good length once again from McGrath, defended back to the bowler on the front foot
tight line and length around off stump, no room for Smith who strides forward and pushes the ball towards cover
and this one is wide, McGrath gets a bit too straight and the ball slants down leg side
a peach from McGrath, he pitches on a good length around off stump, draws Smith forward and then seams the ball past the outside edge of his forward defence, simply superb

a bizarre run out it's all over, Rajasthan are in the finals! Asif worked the ball off his pads towards short fine leg, McGrath had run a long way down the pitch and the fielder threw the ball towards the bowlers end, McGrath made his ground and the ball was backed up by Yusuf, he saw that Asif was taking it easy at the striker's end and had wandered out of his crease, Yusuf fired the throw in to Rawat who calmly broke the stumps with Asif just short of his crease
another short ball this time outside off, McGrath lets it go easily and then walks down the pitch towards Munaf, can't really make put what he's saying
Munaf pins McGrath on to the back foot with a short ball, he defends on the back foot rather awkwardly, Warne's smiling, McGrath got hit on the glove and is in a bit of pain
he's scored! McGrath fends at a short of a length ball and gets an edge on it, the ball runs past the keeper towards the fine leg boundary
Asif gets an inside edge past the stumps for  single

the ninth falls! Yomahesh takes a walk down and tries to hook a short ball from Munaf, he misses and the ball smacks into his shoulder and lobs up towards Rawat who takes the catch, Rajasthan appeal and Rudi nods after a delay, he isn't sure initially but then tentatively raises the finger
banged in short outside off stump, Yomahesh moves back and fends but gets beaten
bowled flat and straight on middle and off, Yomahesh moves back and works the ball towards midwicket
this is the huge legbreak, the batsman has no idea what's going on, Yomahesh gets beaten on the cut
Warne fires in the googly flat and straight, Yomahesh moves back and defends back to the bowler
Warne tosses it up full outside off stump, Asif reaches out and jams his bat down at it, the ball runs past short third man
Yomahesh leans forward and pushes the ball towards midwicket for one
Warne bowls a flat ball on off stump and rips it away from the right-hander, Yomahesh tries to cut but gets beaten
good length delivery angling into middle and leg, worked off the pads behind square
defended once again back to the bowler
tight line and length outside off, Yomahesh defends off the front foot towards the bowler
played towards point once again, for a single this time
he gets a sharp short ball first up, Asif jumps on the back foot and pushes towards point

bowled him! Munaf pitches the ball on a good length and cuts the ball into the right-hander, Mishra tries to work the ball off his pads but it's a feeble attempt, the ball thuds into his pads and hits the stumps off the rebound
the batsman comes forward and tries to close the face to play the ball on the leg side, he gets a leading edge towards the off

caught! Dilshan's fall is surely the end of Delhi's slim chances, Warne loops the ball outside leg stump and spins the ball across the right-hander, Dilshan gets down on one knee and tries to slog sweep, he gets a top edge that flies to fine leg where Tanvir runs forward and catches it
played off the pads behind square on the leg side
whoa!  Warne's playing mind games here, he pitched the ball outside leg stump and turned the ball square across the right-hander, Mishra went on the back foot and watched helplessly
Mishra tries to whack the ball over cover but gets beaten by the big-spinning leg break

caught! Warne's got rid of Maharoof! He cleared his front foot out of the way and tried to loft the legbreak against the spin over midwicket, he didn't hit it well enough and Yusuf Pathan settled under the skier at deep midwicket, Maharoof hit 26 runs off an over from Warne in their last match but Warne got the better of him today
that's a solid shot! Trivedi ends an excellent over with a poor ball, a full toss on leg stump, Dilshan stays where he is and lifts the ball over the long leg boundary
Dilshan takes a step down the track but gets beaten, Trivedi saw him coming and bowled the slower shorter ball
the slower ball from Trivedi, Maharoof pushes towards point for one
he's placed that well, Trivedi bowls the low full toss outside off, Maharoof backs away and opens the face of the bat to slice the ball past backward point for four
Maharoof backs away once again and tries to slog through the leg side, he gets an inside edge that rolls towards the keeper
Maharoof backs away and tries to blast a good length ball which moves away from him through the off side, he gets beaten by Trivedi
a fraction short again and Dilshan gets into position quickly on the back foot and pulls the ball into the gap between deep midwicket and long on
Dilshan moves back and hits the ball against the turn through midwicket, the length was a little shorter from Warne
huge turn from Warne and he spins the ball past the outside edge  of Dilshan's attempted cover drive
the big ripping legbreak which pitches around middle and spins a long way across Dilshan who moves back and lets it go
Maharoof sits on the back foot and cuts the ball in the air over cover
Dilshan waits in his crease and cuts the leg break from Warne towards deep point
the slower ball bowled full outside off, the batsman waits for it and drives firmly towards deep cover

caught! Would you believe it, off a full toss! Karthik flicks a friendly full toss off his pads, he's hit it flat in the air towards deep midwicket where Kaif sprints off the boundary line and slides to take a low catch, well judged and Rajasthan tighten their vice-like grip on this match
Karthik moves outside the line of off stump and tries to work the ball towards the leg side, he gets beaten by a slower ball
short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Karthik plays the ball off his hips behind square for two
Karthik moves on to the back foot and slices the ball in the air towards point, Tanvir dives to his right and the ball flies just past him, poor effort really and Warne isn't pleased
Trivedi cramps Dilshan for room by angling the ball into the right-hander from a good length. Dilshan pushes towards long-on and strolls the single
Karthik moves back and tries to flick towards square leg but gets hit on the pad by a quicker ball, that was the slider and it would have missed leg
Dilshan tries to sweep but hits the ball with the toe end of the bat on the off side
fuller and faster from Warne, Dilshan drives towards Munaf at cover
quicker and flatter ball this time outside off stump, Dilshan waits for it and slices the ball past backward point for four
pitches on middle and off and spins a fair bit away from Karthik who waits on the back foot and cuts through point
Warne gets the ball to turn sharply away from the right-hander, Karthik stretches out for it and hits the ball over cover
another slower ball to end the over, slower than the previous one, Dilshan gets beaten as he tries to hit through the off side
the slower ball outside off stump, Karthik pushes off the front foot and then sprints the single to point, he dives to make his ground
Trivedi beats Karthik's attempted hook with a sharp bouncer
that's not that short and the line is outside off stump but Dilshan gets on to the back foot in a flash and pulls the ball to deep backward square leg, Munaf keeps the batsmen to one
this time Karthik moves into the line of the ball outside off and opens the face to play the ball to third man
he pitches on a good length around off and seams the ball late away from the right-hander, Karthik fends off the back foot and is beaten
now he slashes at a wide delivery outside off and misses
he's hit this with power! Dilshan moves his front foot out of the way and swats a good length delivery back over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
that's lucky, Dilshan pushes forward at a good length delivery which angles into him and the outside edge runs past the keeper for four to third man
Karthik takes a step down the track and pushes the ball on the leg side

another one goes, Tiwary tries to pull off the front foot when the length isn't short enough, the ball hurries on to him and he top-edges between midwicket and mid-on, Asnodkar goes for it from midwicket and nearly collides with Tanvir who came in from mid-on, Asnodkar holds the catch in the end
excellent length and line on off stump, Munaf hits the bat hard as Tiwary defends on the front foot
another short ball and Dilshan tries to pull again, the ball hits the edge of the bat and then hits the body before going to the keeper on the bounce
Watson replies with a sharp bouncer, Dilshan tries to hook but gets beaten completely
thrashed! Dilshan moves forward to a full ball outside of and drives the ball with power through cover point for four to get off the mark
good length delivery pitches outside off and angles into Dilshan who defends on the back foot

caught! Watson's on a roll, he pitches the ball slightly short, it isn't a wicket ball by any means but Dhawan moves back and pulls the ball straight to Jadeja at midwicket, the ball went straight to him, he didn't need to move an inch
Dhawan tries to drive the ball through cover but gets beaten by one that seams away from him
driven back to the bowler and Munaf pulls off a good one-handed save
Another pull but more poor timing, they get a single but that's the first run in 10 balls, Rajasthan turning the screws here
slightly short, pulled but straight to midwicket, no timing there, Dhawan under pressure now
moving away again, thickish edge towards mid-off
beaten outside off, angling away from the left-hander, short of a length and moving away, he tries to dab it to the off side but can't read the movement
Cut towards point, good bit of fielding there

That's a stunner of a catch! Gambhir dances down the track and slaps hard, it's in the air and Taruwar Kohli (the substitute) throws himself to the left at point, extends his arms and plucks off a peach, that was one hell of a catch, Rajasthan are on a roll here. What a big wicket that was
tries to walk down the track and swing to the leg side, another miss, he's going nowhere with these initial movements
clears his front foot and tries to loft over extra cover, no timing there and it's straight to mid-off

full and a bit wide, Gambhir backs away and tries to slash through the covers but can't get to it again, no wide called too, that was touch-and-go but Gambhir's initial movement probably swayed the umpire's decision
well-directed bouncer this, Gambhir tries to swat that through square leg but can't gauge the bounce, looks like he took a step ahead too, good carry there
good-length ball, 136kph, no room again, glided towards third man
bit of width there, crashed through point for four, sweet timing on that occasion, rare bit of width from the man with the Purple cap
full and moving in again, too thick inside edge to mid-on, hardly any room there
too far outside off again, cuts but can't get to that one, wide, says Billy Bowden
full and on-driven to mid-on, swivelled around a bit there
102.9kph, that's the slow bouncer that time, Gambhir tries to slash but can't get to it, appeal from behind the stumps but the bowler isn't interested
full and swinging, nipping back in from outside off. cramped for room totally, thick inside edge onto the pads, he's caught on the back foot
short of a length, moving away after pitching, glided away towards third man for a single
too close to cut, checked his shot and punched to cover for a quick one
tucked away to fine leg, on middle and worked away
short of a length, bit of width, cut away to point, straight to the fielder
full and driven to mid-off for a single

what a big wicket! short and quick, that was well targetted, 132kph, tries to pull hard but that's caught the top edge and rocketed high in the air, he was no way in control of that, Tanvir runs to his left from fine leg and pulls off a sharp catch, he actually ended up taking a one-hander, though he had it covered
130.1kph, full and outside off, stands rooted to the crease and crashes towards mid-off
too far outside off, Gambhir slashes but he was never going to get to that
